The mover 31594839 has 1 of 1 mentions as 'Rethink - Redwoods'. A5 is now sourced. CQC location 1-130502608 is 'Redwoods', 26 Chapelfields Road, Rednal, Birmingham B45 9NU, with registered provider 'Rethink Mental Illness' (provider 1-102643140). The CC extract has no Redwoods charity in Birmingham, and the holder's linked charities are Befriending Visitors Service and Carefund. (a) One holder. (b) Sourced share 1.0 for both members.
